item.title: 2026 United States naval blockade of Iran - Wikipedia
item.description: On 13 April 2026, at 10:00 EDT, the US naval blockade of Iran took effect [43] at the direction of Donald Trump and under the command of Admiral Brad Cooper at CENTCOM. [1] According to CENTCOM, the blockade is set to encompass "the entirety of the Iranian coastline," warning that any vessel "entering or departing the blockaded area without authorization is subject to interception, diversion ...

item.title: US and Iran discuss phased deal to reopen Hormuz and end US blockade ...
item.description: US and Iran explore a phased deal after months of war Proposal for Iran to reopen Hormuz, US to lift blockade Neither side wants to surrender leverage driving diplomacy

item.title: Trump’s blockade pushes Iran toward military escalation | CNN
item.description: As Washington abandons talks with Iran for an aggressive economic pressure campaign, a cornered Tehran is now threatening military escalation and a wider war to force negotiators back to the table.
